originalDsl:
@diagram architecture
layout [direction: DOWN]
Customer service as "Customer"
StoreFront service as "Storefront App"
OrderService service as "Order Service"
InventoryService service as "Inventory Service"
WarehouseDB database as "Warehouse Database"
PaymentService service as "Payment Service"
FraudCheck service as "Fraud Check Service"
PaymentGateway service as "Payment Gateway"
WarehouseSystem service as "Warehouse Management System"
PickPack service as "Pick and Pack Station"
ShippingService service as "Shipping Service"
Carrier service as "Carrier API"
TrackingService service as "Tracking Service"
NotifyService service as "Notification Service"
ReturnsService service as "Returns Service"
RefundService service as "Refund Service"

edge_1 = Customer -> StoreFront as "places order"
edge_2 = StoreFront -> OrderService as "submit order"
edge_3 = OrderService -> InventoryService as "check stock"
edge_4 = InventoryService -> WarehouseDB as "read/write stock levels"
edge_5 = OrderService -> PaymentService as "charge customer"
edge_6 = PaymentService -> FraudCheck as "screen transaction"
edge_7 = PaymentService -> PaymentGateway as "process payment"
edge_8 = OrderService -> WarehouseSystem as "send fulfillment request"
edge_9 = WarehouseSystem -> PickPack as "assign pick task"
edge_10 = PickPack -> ShippingService as "package ready"
edge_11 = ShippingService -> Carrier as "book shipment"
edge_12 = Carrier -> TrackingService as "provide tracking number"
edge_13 = TrackingService -> NotifyService as "send updates"
edge_14 = OrderService -> NotifyService as "send confirmation"
edge_15 = Customer -> ReturnsService as "request return"
edge_16 = ReturnsService -> RefundService as "approve refund"
edge_17 = RefundService -> PaymentGateway as "refund via"
edge_18 = ReturnsService -> InventoryService as "restock item"

injectedDefects.description: removed opening quote on label "Notification Service"
